manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pour all the water from the bowl on the left into the bowl on the right.

Task description: Of the two light-blue bowls on the table, the left one contains water and the right one is to catch it. Only the right arm is available this round; use it to handle and pour from the left bowl, avoiding spilling water on the table.

Success criteria: All the water from the left bowl has entered the right bowl. No water remains in the left bowl, and none has spilled onto the table.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the left bowl wall below the rim with one finger inside and one outside, selecting an accessible section away from the planned pouring edge. Ensure full pad contact with both surfaces and match the opening to wall thickness and clearance, avoiding a grasp only on the smooth rim top.
- Before closing, use different views if possible to confirm that both fingers are truly on opposite sides of the bowl wall. Test-lift slightly to check for slipping; if another grasp is needed, first let the bowl base rest on the table again.
- Keep the water bowl opening upward during transport and change speed and pose smoothly to reduce premature spilling from liquid sloshing.
- During pouring, position the pouring edge close above the interior of the right opening while preserving bowl clearance. Watch the swept space of the left bowl bottom and rotating gripper to avoid collisions or water falling outside.
- Increase tilt slightly while observing where the water lands. As flow diminishes, pause to let residual water gather along the wall at the pouring edge. During return to upright, keep the dripping edge above the right bowl opening to avoid final drops on the table.
